rationale: Ahmad is building AI-native hardware at Midjourney with deep conviction that next-gen interfaces require tight integration between spatial computing, hand-tracking, and generative AI — not bolt-on wearables. Sean is shipping direct-manipulation AR interfaces at Fusion Reality that reject voice-only paradigms in favor of users physically interacting with objects through smart glasses and AI. They're attacking the same hardware-software frontier from complementary angles: Ahmad has the systems-level hardware expertise (Vision Pro, Leap Motion, FPGA/PCB design) while Sean has the interaction research and applied spatial computing stack (WebXR, Gemini integration) to validate what users actually want from AI glasses.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Xiaoan (Sean) Liu — you're both betting that AI + spatial computing + direct manipulation interfaces are the next computing platform, and your hardware + interaction design expertise would likely be useful to compare notes on.
